en.headline: PETIT FACTORY Christmas installation opens at Kai Tak Cullinan Sky Mall
en.dek: The Korean brand's first Hong Kong Christmas theme features a 4.5-metre clock tower, starlight displays and pop-up shop until early January.
body: Cullinan Sky Mall in Kai Tak launched the PETIT FACTORY Christmas Starlight Dream Factory on Thursday, the first Hong Kong appearance of the Korean healing-themed creative brand.

The mall said the installation centres on a nearly 4.5-metre-high clock tower in the ground-floor atrium, with characters RURU, MIKO and PEPEO, a starlight wish tree, and an eight-metre fantasy train on the second-floor sky garden.
A pop-up shop selling brand merchandise runs alongside free interactive games such as Christmas tree stacking. The displays are open during mall hours until 3 January, according to the organisers.
The Point members who spend HK$500 or more via electronic payment can redeem a mini light box, subject to availability, the mall said.

zh.headline: 啟德天璽天Mall呈獻PETIT FACTORY聖誕星光夢工場
zh.dek: 韓國療癒系品牌首度登陸香港，設近4.5米鐘樓、星光裝置及快閃店，展期至1月3日。
body: 啟德天璽•天Mall周四起呈獻全港首個韓國PETIT FACTORY主題聖誕企劃「聖誕星光夢工場」。
商場表示，裝置以地下中庭近4.5米高大型鐘樓為中心，主角RURU、MIKO及PEPEO現身，另有星光願望樹及二樓空中花園8米長星光夢幻號。
同場設有快閃限定店售賣文創精品，以及免費聖誕樹疊疊樂等互動遊戲。據主辦方指，裝置於商場營業時間內開放至1月3日。
The Point會員以電子貨幣消費滿500元可換領迷你療癒小燈箱，數量有限，換完即止。
